questions.text: Are you working or studying at the moment?

cueCard.topic: Describe a place where you like to study or work.
cueCard.explain: and explain why you like to study or work in this place.

questions.text: Describe a place where you like to study or work.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a place where you like to study or work. You should say: where it is; what it looks like; how often you go there; and explain why you like to study or work in this place.

questions.text: Do other people you know also like to study or work there?
questions.say: Thank you. Do other people you know also like to study or work there?

questions.text: What makes a good place to study?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a place where you like to study or work, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all places to study. What makes a good place to study?

questions.text: Do students today study differently from students in the past?
